card.name: Small linking words in label phrases
card.fires_on: Short linking words (of, in, to, within, resume) in fixed label phrases, mostly the "of" in "KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN". Also "Do not use in" and "not limited to".

modes.label: The phrase about keeping out of reach
modes.description: The word "of" right after "keep out" in the child-safety warning.
modes.example: KEEP OUT<< OF>> REACH OF CHILDREN.

modes.description: A linking word inside stock phrases such as "Do not use in" or "including, but not limited to".

modes.description: A short verb or preposition inside dosing instructions.
